008package release;
009
010import javax.swing.*;
011import java.awt.*;
012import java.io.BufferedReader;
013import java.io.IOException;
014import java.io.InputStreamReader;
015import java.nio.file.Path;
016import java.util.Arrays;
017import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
018import java.util.List;
019import java.util.Map;
020
021/**
022 * Interactive CLI utility to select modules and platforms for the build process.
023 */
024public class BuildSelector {
025
026    private static final Path PROJECT_ROOT =
027            Path.of(System.getProperty("user.dir")).toAbsolutePath();
028    private final List<Task> tasks = Arrays.asList(
029            // macOS apps
030            new Task("Viewer.app", "paint-viewer",
031                     "mvn", "-q", "-U", "clean", "package", "-P", "macos-appbundle"),
032
033            new Task("Generate Squares.app", "paint-generate-squares",
034                     "mvn", "-q", "-U", "clean", "package", "-P", "macos-appbundle"),
035
036            new Task("Create Experiment.app", "paint-create-experiment",
037                     "mvn", "-q", "-U", "clean", "package", "-P", "macos-appbundle"),
038
039            new Task("Get Omero.app", "paint-get-omero",
040                     "mvn", "-q", "-U", "clean", "package", "-P", "macos-appbundle"),
041
042            // Windows apps
043            new Task("Viewer.exe", "paint-viewer",
044                     "mvn", "-q", "-U", "clean", "package", "-P", "windows-exe"),
045
046            new Task("Generate Squares.exe", "paint-generate-squares",
047                     "mvn", "-q", "-U", "clean", "package", "-P", "windows-exe"),
048
049            new Task("Create Experiment.exe", "paint-create-experiment",
050                     "mvn", "-q", "-U", "clean", "package", "-P", "windows-exe"),
051
052            new Task("Get Omero.exe", "paint-get-omero",
053                     "mvn", "-q", "-U", "clean", "package", "-P", "windows-exe"),
054
055            // Fiji plugin
056            new Task("Fiji Plugin (shaded JAR)", "paint-fiji-plugin",
057                     "mvn", "-q", "-U", "clean", "install")
058    );
059    private final Map<Task, JCheckBox> boxes = new LinkedHashMap<>();
060    private JTextArea log;
061    private JButton   runBtn;
062
063    public static void main(String[] args) {
064        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> new BuildSelector().show());
065    }
066
067    private void show() {
068        JFrame frame = new JFrame("Glyco-PAINT – Deliverables Builder");
069        frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
070        frame.setSize(700, 800);
071        frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null);
072        frame.setLayout(new BorderLayout(10, 10));
073
074        JPanel north = new JPanel();
075        north.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(10, 10, 0, 10));
076        north.setLayout(new BoxLayout(north, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
077
078        addSection(north, "macOS Applications");
079        addBoxes(north, 0, 4);
080
081        addSection(north, "Windows Applications");
082        addBoxes(north, 4, 8);
083
084        addSection(north, "Plugin");
085        addBoxes(north, 8, 9);
086
087        frame.add(north, BorderLayout.NORTH);
088
089        log = new JTextArea();
090        log.setEditable(false);
091        log.setFont(new Font(Font.MONOSPACED, Font.PLAIN, 12));
092        frame.add(new JScrollPane(log), BorderLayout.CENTER);
093
094        JPanel south = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT));
095        JButton closeBtn = new JButton("Close");
096        runBtn = new JButton("Generate");
097
098        closeBtn.addActionListener(e -> System.exit(0));
099        runBtn.addActionListener(e -> runSelectedTasks());
100
101        south.add(closeBtn);
102        south.add(runBtn);
103
104        frame.add(south, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
105
106        frame.setVisible(true);
107    }
108
109    private void addSection(JPanel parent, String title) {
110        JPanel spacer = new JPanel();
111        spacer.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(1, 20));
112        spacer.setOpaque(false);
113        parent.add(spacer);
114
115        JLabel lbl = new JLabel(title);
116        lbl.setFont(lbl.getFont().deriveFont(Font.BOLD, 14f));
117        parent.add(lbl);
118    }
119
120    private void addBoxes(JPanel parent, int from, int to) {
121        JPanel boxPanel = new JPanel();
122        boxPanel.setLayout(new BoxLayout(boxPanel, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
123        boxPanel.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(5, 20, 5, 0));
124
125        for (int i = from; i < to; i++) {
126            Task t = tasks.get(i);
127            JCheckBox box = new JCheckBox(" " + t.label);
128            boxes.put(t, box);
129            boxPanel.add(box);
130        }
131
132        parent.add(boxPanel);
133    }
134
135    private void runSelectedTasks() {
136        runBtn.setEnabled(false);
137
138        new Thread(() -> {
139            try {
140                append("=== Installing shared utils first ===");
141                runSharedUtils();
142
143                append("\n=== Running selected builds ===\n");
144
145                for (Task t : boxes.keySet()) {
146                    if (!boxes.get(t).isSelected()) {
147                        continue;
148                    }
149                    runTask(t);
150                }
151
152                append("\n✅ Finished all selected builds.\n");
153
154            } catch (Exception ex) {
155                append("\n❌ " + ex.getMessage());
156            } finally {
157                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> runBtn.setEnabled(true));
158            }
159        }).start();
160    }
161
162    private void runSharedUtils() throws IOException, InterruptedException {
163        Path utilsDir = PROJECT_ROOT.resolve("paint-shared-utils");
164        append("→ Building paint-shared-utils (installing into local repo)");
165        append("  Dir: " + utilsDir);
166
167        List<String> cmd = Arrays.asList(
168                "mvn", "-q", "-U", "clean", "install", "-DskipTests"
169        );
170
171        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);
172        pb.directory(utilsDir.toFile());
173        pb.redirectErrorStream(true);
174
175        Process p = pb.start();
176        try (BufferedReader r =
177                     new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(p.getInputStream()))) {
178
179            String line;
180            while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) {
181                append("[paint-shared-utils] " + line);
182            }
183        }
184
185        int exit = p.waitFor();
186        if (exit != 0) {
187            throw new IOException("Failed building paint-shared-utils (exit " + exit + ")");
188        }
189
190        append("✅ Installed paint-shared-utils\n");
191    }
192
193    private void runTask(Task t) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
194        append("→ Building " + t.label);
195        append("  Cmd: " + String.join(" ", t.mavenCmd));
196        append("  Dir: " + t.moduleDir + "\n");
197
198        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(t.mavenCmd);
199        pb.directory(t.moduleDir.toFile());
200        pb.redirectErrorStream(true);
201
202        Process p = pb.start();
203        try (BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(p.getInputStream()))) {
204
205            String line;
206            while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) {
207                if (line.contains("sun.misc.Unsafe") || line.contains("HiddenClassDefiner")) {
208                    continue;
209                }
210                append("[" + t.moduleDir.getFileName() + "] " + line);
211            }
212        }
213
214        int exit = p.waitFor();
215        if (exit != 0) {
216            throw new IOException("Failed building " + t.label + " (exit " + exit + ")");
217        }
218
219        append("✅ Built " + t.label + "\n");
220    }
221
222    private void append(String s) {
223        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
224            log.append(s + "\n");
225            log.setCaretPosition(log.getDocument().getLength());
226        });
227    }
228
229    private static class Task {
230        final String label;
231        final Path moduleDir;
232        final List<String> mavenCmd;
233
234        Task(String label, String module, String... cmd) {
235            this.label = label;
236            this.moduleDir = PROJECT_ROOT.resolve(module);
237            this.mavenCmd = Arrays.asList(cmd);
238        }
239    }
240}
